subject: Intro: Aligning evaluation & close timeline (Heliox)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Brooks <erin@heliox.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Intro: Aligning evaluation & close timeline (Heliox)

Hi Erin —

Great to meet you over email. I’m Monica (AE on this account) — looping in Lauren (our Sales Manager) and Karthik (solutions/technical lead) so we can align on a pragmatic evaluation plan and close timeline.

Goal in this thread: confirm success criteria, key stakeholders, and a realistic timeline so we can land a pilot and commercial decision cleanly. My proposal below is meant to be a starting point we can adjust:

High-level objectives
- Validate model quality on your anonymized customer transcripts
- Measure latency/throughput for your production SLAs
- Estimate per-call unit economics with suggested batching/cache profile

Proposed 6-week timeline (flexible)
1) Week 0 (this week): kickoff + stakeholder roster + access checklist
2) Week 1: technical baseline & dataset handoff
3) Week 2–3: pilot runs and initial eval metrics
4) Week 4: cross-functional review (product & security)
5) Week 5: business review & exec summary
6) Week 6: contract & procurement loop close (if green)

Attachments: I attached a starting MAP workbook (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) with responsibilities, dates, and deliverables. Can you confirm:
- Who will be the Heliox champion for the pilot?
- Any mandatory procurement milestones we should account for? (PO, vendor packages, third-party security review)
- Any blackout dates in July we should avoid for demo/live runs?

Suggested next step: 30-min sync this week to finalize the roster and lock the kickoff date. I’m available Thu 7/1 10–12 PT or Fri 7/2 09–11 PT — if neither works, propose a time that does.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0127

--
Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet; contains milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria)

From: Erin Brooks <erin@heliox.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.k@heliox.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Intro: Aligning evaluation & close timeline (Heliox)

Monica — thanks for the clear note and the MAP draft. I’m happy to act as the Heliox champion for now. I’ve looped in Samir (Head of Platforms) — he’ll own the dataset and the technical side.

A couple of constraints from our side:
- Procurement typically takes ~6 weeks for external vendors at our org, so the overall calendar will likely land closer to 8 weeks for contract completion.
- Security will want a quick pass at the SOC2 snapshot and evidence before pilot infra is provisioned — can you share an extracted PDF of the control summary?
- We have a company-wide freeze the week of July 19–23 (quarterly maintenance), so avoid demos that week.

With those constraints, proposed adjustments: move business review to Week 6 and contract week to Week 8. Still happy to proceed with a technical kickoff next week. Thu 7/1 10:30 PT works for me.

Best,
Erin Brooks
Director of Product, Heliox Technologies
erin@heliox.ai | +1 415-555-3344

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:46:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Intro: Aligning evaluation & close timeline (Heliox)

Thanks Erin — this is perfect context.

I’ve updated the attached MAP to reflect an 8-week close and the July 19–23 freeze. See column "Adjusted Dates" in the workbook. I also included a short checklist for procurement (vendor packet, PO template, and contract owner).

I’m attaching a SOC2 control snapshot (SOC2_snapshot.pdf) to accelerate the security pass. If security wants more detail we can provision the redacted report under NDA.

We’ll hold a 30-min technical kickoff Thu 7/1 at 10:30 PT to confirm data handoff and roles (invite sent). Proposed attendees: Erin, Samir, Karthik, myself, and an infra engineer (TBD). If you want a short pre-read, the Drive link has the MAP and the evaluation rubric: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/heliox/Redwood_MAP_v1

Next steps (action owners):
- Erin / Samir: confirm dataset access and owner (by 7/2)
- Redwood (Karthik): provide infra checklist and temporary creds (by 7/2)
- Redwood (Monica): finalize kickoff agenda and send calendar invite (done)

Thanks — see you Thu.

Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

--
Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), SOC2_snapshot.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Erin Brooks <erin@heliox.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:10:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Intro: Aligning evaluation & close timeline (Heliox)

Quick note ahead of the 10:30 PT kickoff — thanks for lining this up. A couple of operational asks so the pilot can start smoothly: 

Tech checklist (what I’ll cover on the call)
- Minimal data sample: 10–20 anonymized transcripts + schema and retention policy
- Network whitelist (IP ranges) and temporary S3 access role or secure upload link
- Expected QPS/peak concurrency for the pilot environment

If you can share the sample and a point of contact for infra (Samir?) prior to the call we’ll provision a temporary cluster and smoke-test within 48 hours. I’ll also bring our cost/latency estimator so we can produce a short projection on the call.

Looking forward —
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
